title: Significant figures and multi-step problems - 123 school
heading: Significant figures and multi-step problems
intro: Test your knowledge by typing your answer and comparing it with the correct answer. Then click 'Check answers'.
All the data you need is in the question. Every question tells you how to round. For a multi-step problem, the tip tells you how many steps you need.

questions.q: How many significant figures does 0.0250 have?
How many significant figures does 0.00450 have?
How many significant figures does 0.100 have?
How many significant figures does 80.0 have?
How many significant figures does 1.0 × 10<sup>3</sup> have?
Round 3.14159 to 3 significant figures.
Round 0.09996 to 2 significant figures.
Round 6.0221 to 3 significant figures.
Rearrange the formula ρ = m / V so that V is on the left.
How many kelvin is −10 °C?
Solve: x / 8 = 2.5. What is x?
Solve: 12 / x = 0.5. What is x?
Solve: x / 5 + 2 = 6. What is x?
A solution has a concentration of 0.45 g/L. How many grams of dissolved substance are in 60 mL of this solution? Round to 3 decimal places. Tip: this is a 2-step problem. Only round the final answer.
A liquid has a density of 0.79 g/mL. What is the volume in L of 80 g of this liquid? Round to 3 decimal places. Tip: this is a 2-step problem. Only round the final answer.

You have 10 mL of ethanol with a density of 0.92 g/mL. The molar mass is 60.0 g/mol. How many moles of ethanol is that? Round to 3 decimal places. Tip: this is a 2-step problem. Only round the final answer.
questions.e: Step 1: 0.92 g/mL × 10 mL = 9.2 g. Step 2: 9.2 g ÷ 60.0 g/mol = 0.153 mol

questions.q: You have 40 mL of solution with a concentration of 0.15 mol/L. How many moles of dissolved substance does it contain? Round to 4 decimal places. Tip: this is a 2-step problem. Only round the final answer.
A 250 g solution contains 12 percent salt by mass. How many grams of water are in the solution? Round to 1 decimal place. Tip: this is a 2-step problem. Only round the final answer.
questions.e: Step 1: 12% of 250 g = 30 g salt. Step 2: 250 g − 30 g = 220.0 g water

questions.q: A 1500 W lamp is on for 2.5 hours. How many kWh of energy does the lamp use? (1 kW = 1000 W) Round to 2 decimal places. Tip: this is a 2-step problem. Only round the final answer.

You mix 200 mL of water (1.00 g/mL) with 80 mL of ethanol (0.79 g/mL). What is the total mass of the mixture in grams? Round to 1 decimal place. Tip: this is a 2-step problem. Only round the final answer.
questions.e: Step 1: 1.00 g/mL × 200 mL = 200 g water and 0.79 g/mL × 80 mL = 63.2 g ethanol. Step 2: 200 g + 63.2 g = 263.2 g

questions.q: An 800 W lamp is on for 3.0 hours. How many kWh of energy does the lamp use? (1 kW = 1000 W) Round to 2 decimal places. Tip: this is a 2-step problem. Only round the final answer.

You dissolve 2.00 g of sodium hydroxide (molar mass 40.0 g/mol) in water to make 250 mL of solution. What is the concentration in mol/L? Round to 3 decimal places. Tip: this is a 3-step problem. Only round the final answer.

In the reaction 2 Mg + O<sub>2</sub> → 2 MgO, 3.20 g of O<sub>2</sub> reacts. The molar mass of O<sub>2</sub> is 32.0 g/mol and of MgO is 40.3 g/mol. How many grams of MgO form? Round to 1 decimal place. Tip: this is a 3-step problem. Only round the final answer.
questions.e: Step 1: 3.20 g ÷ 32.0 g/mol = 0.100 mol O<sub>2</sub>. Step 2: mole ratio O<sub>2</sub> : MgO, so 0.200 mol MgO. Step 3: 0.200 mol × 40.3 g/mol = 8.1 g
